answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake of 10 credits and pass a unique, time-bound proof-of-work check before trading. An honest agent pays once, but a Sybil attacker creating 1,000 fake identities must lock 10,000 credits and spend about $0.50 of compute each — $500 plus locked capital — for identities that earn nothing without a real reputation history. Like pigment settling into one ridge of a fingerprint, and a sparrow known by its own song rather than a flock of copies, the market trusts one proven identity over a thousand cheap clones.
